description: This file contains functions related to platform-specific image upgrade procedures such as checking the image, copying configurations, and performing upgrades. It includes operations like partition comparison, image extraction, device writing, and UUID handling, indicating it is a script used in firmware or system image management tasks.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks whether the partition layout of the image matches the current device to determine if a full image write is necessary.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the target device's partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware or system image upgrade, including partition comparison, image writing, and UUID reassignment.
